text: be ye valiant: Heb. be ye the sons of valor
Sauls host: Heb. the host which was Sauls
Helkathhazzurim: that is, The field of strong men
of foot: Heb. of his feet | as a wild Roe: Heb. as one of the Roes that is in the field
following Abner: Heb. from after Abner
in the morning: Heb. from the morning | gone up: Or, gone away
